title: Stop scheduling and configuring Ubuntu desktop daily-dangerous builds
commit_message:
Stop scheduling and configuring Ubuntu desktop daily-dangerous builds

The Ubuntu desktop "dangerous" images (the daily-dangerous image type
for the ubuntu project) built live desktop images with all snaps from the
edge channel, for quicker testing of snapd, the prompting client, the
desktop installer, etc. They are now redundant, so stop building them.

Remove the cron entry, the daily-dangerous entry-point script, the livefs
Launchpad mapping, the default-arches and purge-days entries, and the
README documentation block.

https://warthogs.atlassian.net/browse/ADT-1912
